title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode7 Undoubtedly Ultimate

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
I thought you were listening with the others in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I had a feeling that you'd be going on soon, so I wanted to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I sort of need to focus...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you feeling excited right now, Kohane?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What's your heart telling you? Is it beating the same way it did that day?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it is beating really hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I don't think it's for the same reason.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm mainly thinking about what I have to do. The pressure to succeed, to surpass that night...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And what I want is taking a back seat to that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which isn't good, right?
After figuring out what it is I really want to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<There's nothing you can do about that.
After all, this place is a whirlpool of emotions. It's easy to lose sight of what you're feeling.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right now, Kohane, you're in front of a big wall that's standing between you and a brand-new world.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <There's no telling what's waiting for you on the other side. Nobody knows.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
With everyone from Vivid BAD SQUAD.
With all of the friends who've been singing by our side—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe.
There's more to it than that though, isn't there?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Don't worry. You'll realize when you're on the stage.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane! Let's go!
Wait, Miku, you came to visit?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you get bored of just listening from SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is Miku we're talking about.
You came to show us your support, yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <No fair, Miku! Quit hogging all the fun!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Anyway, we also came to show you guys our support! Go knock their socks off!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We're looking forward to seeing your best performance ever!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Go out there and sing with all the feeling you can muster! Then, you should all be able to surpass that night!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You can do it!
We all believe in you!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We're looking forward to hearing the best performance you've ever done.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Let's go see what's waiting for us in the new world. Together.>

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Alright, last but not least! It's Vivid BAD SQUAD!!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It's time to surpass that legendary night!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: There they are! Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Give us the best finale ever!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!! We're gonna blow this place sky-high!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Some of you, including me, were here when that legendary night happened.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But we're gonna surpass it today!
All of us! Together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The eagerness to witness an event that's better than RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The hope that we'll surpass it without the legend of Nagi and her team being forgotten.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The desire for us to see what lies beyond their dream.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's a torrent of emotions, whirling around like a firestorm.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's time to live up to their expectations. It's time to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's time to give them what they want... And set this place alight!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We couldn't have asked for a better start!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (All that's left is to keep turning up the heat!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
...!
Wh-Whoa, this song...! This is my first time hearing it, but...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: It's really hitting home with me...!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know we're trying to scale a terrifyingly high wall, but my spirit is soaring.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The song I wrote...
It's propelling me... It's propelling us higher and higher.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I never knew that I could feel this way.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I should use this to push us forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So that we can see what's waiting for us on the other side of that wall!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Why's this song so good...?!
Everyone's bouncing off the walls!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
I have no idea!
But this song's totally off the hook...!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't know whatever deities might be listening.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I'm willing to put everything I have on offer after this is over.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The power to sing with absolutely everything I have!)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
He's got so good...!
He used to be terrible...

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Argh...!
I wanna sing more! I wanna get better like them!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
...!
Shiraishi's singing on the same level as Taiga...!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We're gonna make them a reality and build our future!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We're gonna go where Aunt Nagi couldn't!!)

rows.Speaker: Old Locals
rows.Line: This feels just like RAD WEEKEND...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But we haven't surpassed it yet. The door isn't open.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Shinonome and Aoyagi are leading the way.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And An's raising the temperature even higher.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're setting the stage perfectly for me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's time for us to see what's waiting for us beyond RAD WEEKEND!!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Everything's gone quiet...
No, that's not it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I can see their faces clearly...
Oh...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone who watched me practice on my own. Everyone who did those events with us.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And all the locals who listen to me sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh...
The owner and everyone else from the record store... They're all covered in sweat.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The lady who gave me that crepe, the man who complimented me, the owners of Crawl Green and COL...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There are so many more people here compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (“Everyone” doesn't include the people I sing with.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What it's like to witness a torrent of emotions like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to take everyone here to a place they've never been before.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because I love this neighborhood so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The locals all love music and cared deeply about Nagi. It's why RAD WEEKEND has such a special place in their hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which is why we're still at RAD WEEKEND. We're still stuck in that time and place... That moment...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I want everyone to be there when we surpass it. I want everyone to feel exhilarated by our singing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(So, everyone, let's go...
Actually, no. You're coming with me whether you like it or not.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow... I didn't realize how self-centered I really was...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to take this entire neighborhood with me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taking that first step is always scary...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We get to experience a brand-new world.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There's going to be no greater feeling than that!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: How's she able to sing like this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (This place is a whirlpool of emotions.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (The resolve to carry on a legacy.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(But that night... That place...
There was something much simpler at work.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Let's just try to have fun today, alright?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And make this an unforgettable day.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (What it boiled down to was this.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (When we were kids, we spent entire weekends at COL singing until we dropped. We weren't weighed down by having to think about record companies, our target audience or anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (We sang the way we wanted like there was no tomorrow. Haha. Pretty simple when you lay it out like that.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (We just did what we wanted to...!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(You remind us of that, Kohane.
You remind everyone of that.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, all that's left is for us to give them something new to hear!!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
You can do it...
You've got this!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Show them what you've got, Vivid BAD SQUAD!!!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Come on!!! You can do it!!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's so hot...! I feel like I'm burning up...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We have to use this energy to sing even louder...!!!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We have to push the door open!!!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So this is what you wanted, Nagi?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You guys are awesome, Vivid BAD SQUAD!!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They did it! They really did it...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: This is the best event I've ever been to!!

rows.Speaker: Old Locals
rows.Line: I've never seen anything like this before...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An, sorry...
I started to feel woozy and...

rows.Speaker: Record Shop Owner
rows.Line:
Incredible...!
An, all of you, you were absolutely incredible!!!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
I'm sure Nagi's watching from somewhere...
There's no way she'd ever miss a party like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
Don't throw yourself at us like that!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Haha. You all look exhausted.
But this does seem like the right time to be celebrating, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
You guys were unbelievable!!
I got goosebumps just listening offstage...!!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
That was amazing... Beyond amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Man, your face is a mess!
But so is mine probably...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Your performance was so moving.
I was honestly left speechless...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And we wouldn't have been able to come this far if it weren't for you, Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Obviously! We're awesome, and that's a fact!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But so are you guys! You all did such an amazing job today!
